name: closeForumTopic
description: Use this method to close an open topic in a forum supergroup chat. The bot must be an administrator in the chat for this to work and must have the _can\_manage\_topics_ administrator rights, unless it is the creator of the topic. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup in the format `@username`

parameters.name: message_thread_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target message thread of the forum topic
